title: Cross-Lingual Persona Effects in LLM Negotiation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00300v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tell an LLM negotiator to be "headstrong" and it should hold firm on price, but does that instruction retain the same behavior in every language? To test this, we use identical buyer and seller instances of Gemini 3.6 Flash to negotiate the same 12 CraigslistBargain scenarios in English and Korean. The pilot-scale 2 x 2 x 3 design crosses interaction language, seller urgency (none or strong), and buyer persona (cooperative, neutral, or headstrong), yielding 432 attempted negotiations. We call this property cross-lingual social-policy fidelity: whether a prompt-defined social policy produces the same behavioral effect regardless of interaction language. It often does not. Korean negotiations reached agreement far more often than English (77.3% vs. 52.5%, a 24.8-point gap, Holm-adjusted p = .0039), but only for neutral and headstrong buyers; cooperative buyers were already near-ceiling in both languages. translated_title: 大语言模型谈判中的跨语言人设效应
translated_abstract: 告诉一个LLM谈判者要“固执己见”，它应该在价格上坚持立场，但这种指令在每种语言中都能保持相同的行为吗？为了验证这一点，我们使用相同的买家和卖家Gemini 3.6 Flash实例，在英语和韩语中对相同的12个CraigslistBargain场景进行谈判。这项试点规模的2×2×3实验设计交叉了交互语言、卖家紧迫感（无或强）和买家人格（合作型、中立型或固执型），共产生432次谈判尝试。我们将这一特性称为跨语言社会策略保真度：即提示词定义的社会策略无论交互语言如何，都能产生相同的行为效应。但实际情况往往并非如此。韩语谈判达成协议的频率远高于英语（77.3% vs. 52.5%，差距24.8个百分点，Holm校正p = .0039），但这仅适用于中立型和固执型买家；合作型买家在两种语言中都已接近上限。买家的初始报价几乎没有差异
tldr: 该研究提出“跨语言社会策略保真度”这一新概念，通过实验发现LLM谈判中提示词定义的人格行为在不同语言间不一致——韩语谈判达成协议率（77.3%）显著高于英语（52.5%），且该差异仅出现在中立和固执型买家中，表明跨语言部署时社会策略的可靠性存在隐患。
en_tdlr: This study introduces "cross-lingual social-policy fidelity" and reveals that prompt-defined personas in LLM negotiation behave inconsistently across languages—Korean negotiations reached agreement far more often than English (77.3% vs. 52.5%), with the gap appearing only for neutral and headstrong buyers.
